scope: views.js:itemEffects, equipmentRail, gold comparison/overflow descriptions, all actual effect trigger/rounding/cap paths, new targeted tests and auditor.
checks: criticalFollow is conditional on a critical roll with best>=2; fixed modifier is additive to chance and remains constrained by the final 85% follow cap.
Ordinary pierce bypasses a fraction of shield absorption from total damage; it does not itself raise total damage or unshielded damage.

regen requires survival after combat retaliation in resolveRoll and floors maxHp*regen; fate/forge dice do not activate it. pairWard requires best>=2 and the full ward sum is rounded before retaliation.
barrier adds its maxHp-based amount on encounter entry; retry remains the existing replacement ward behavior.
healBonus adds to the existing kill-heal coefficient; the total is rounded upward against post-XP maxHp and actual HP remains capped.
followDamage adds to the base 35% plus pursuit coefficient before rounding a main-hit fraction; inactive follow contributes zero.
goldBonus affects generated chest gold only; fate, gold room, exchange and salvage controls retain their ordinary rewards.
All raw item numeric values and engine caps remain unchanged. Text values remain item contributions, not guaranteed marginal effective bonuses after aggregate caps or HP filling.
Controlled catalogs preserve base stats/profile/rarity and use inactive firstBonus as a comparison, avoiding first-turn damage confounding.
New tests preserve original-save immutability, validate committed states, and verify decoded deterministic continuation.

Gold aggregation order: every *Bonus key is first clamped to 0.6; the later goldBonus:1 named cap is nonbinding. Luck overflow is then added as min(0.5, luckOverflow*0.002). This is not the cap of all other chest-gold talents, and the numerical upper guard is not a claim about an attainable current loadout.

findings.detail: EquipmentRail title prefix, chest-gold labels and fusion-view.js independent comparison labels are aligned through display-only aliases. Detailed regen now says 战斗掷骰后存活; compact labels retain their concise accurate triggers.

Draft gameplay documentation treated the named goldBonus:1 table as the effective base cap. The real generic *Bonus clamp applies first. The author corrected documentation to the exact 0.6-plus-overflow formula without changing source or data.

limitations: No independent browser measurement or screen-reader execution in this review.
Fixtures are synthetic valid-save states, not natural-player trajectories.
Targeted test and audit counts overlap; do not add them to full-suite unique totals.
